notes: Prompt descriptions reconstructed from the production brief; not a verbatim API transcript. Five generations, one coherent art kit. Original PNG filenames are provenance identifiers; final runtime assets are bundled WebP files.
shared_direction: Original hand-painted illustrated moonlit woodland adventure. Orthographic three-quarter top-down camera, screen-aligned horizontal and vertical axes, no diamond isometric grid. Tactile illustrated paper, intricate foliage, soft warm amber lanterns against teal and indigo moonlight. Readable silhouettes, shared scale and materials. No existing game characters, logos, text or UI.

assets.prompt: Portrait 3:4 hand-painted moonlit woodland conservatory environment for an original illustrated adventure game. Ornate trees, ivy and lanterns at perimeter, rich warm amber versus teal and indigo, tactile paper detail. Center mostly open continuous flagstone floor for gameplay. Orthographic three-quarter top-down, horizontal and vertical axes, no diamond grid. No characters, interface, lettering or gameplay props in the center.

Transparent-background 4-column by 3-row directional walking sprite sheet matching the woodland illustration. Original little russet fox with cream muzzle, teal cloak, mustard scarf, brown boots, brass lantern and fluffy cream-tipped tail. Four down-facing walking poses in row one, four up-facing in row two, four right-facing in row three. Consistent scale, camera, costume and character identity. Entire bodies, tails and ears within each cell, generous transparent gutters, no labels or text.

Transparent-background nine-prop sheet matching the forest camera, painted materials and palette. Three columns by three rows: mossy low stone wall, closed ornate brass gate, corresponding open gate; unlit circular moon pad, matching illuminated pad, moon-bell shrine; glowing moth, purple bellflower portal, stone wind fan. Complete silhouettes with transparent separation. Warm brass, mossy stone, teal shadow, delicate magical lighting. No lettering or UI.

Portrait 3:4 moonlit botanical observatory and library environment in exactly the shared forest illustration style and orthographic top-down camera. Perimeter shelves, star charts, brass telescopes and botanical details. Lavender-blue flagstone floor mostly clear through the center for gameplay, warm local lanterns, indigo moonlight, intricate coherent hand-painted detail. No characters, text or UI, no central obstacles.

Portrait 3:4 warm autumn conservatory environment in the same painted style and camera as the woodland reference. Bronze glasshouse ribs, amber lanterns, orange foliage and beautiful border planting. Open blue-grey flagstones across the center for gameplay. Soft moonlight, tactile painted detail and restrained warm/cool contrast. No characters, interface, text or central gameplay props.

pipeline: Backgrounds resized to 900x1200 and encoded as WebP quality 86. Sprite sheets encoded with alpha as WebP quality 90. Per-sprite alpha bounds and individual foot anchors in assets/atlas.json. Separate source regions preserve props that do not align exactly to the generated nominal grid. No original PNGs are required at runtime.
